note: How the game decides what the band plays. design/music/track*.json holds one staged run written out bar by bar ('arrangement'), for listening; in the game the same patterns are switched by these rules from the director's intensity, the section of the phrase cycle and each player's loadout. Layer names are the pattern and voice names of the Track files. Steps are sixteenths (16 per bar). Everything changes on a bar line unless it says otherwise. Starting values: tune by ear at the M2 and M3 checkpoints.

bed.note: Layers of the shared bed in Groove, switched on as director intensity (0..1) rises and off again 0.05 lower, so a layer does not flicker.

layers.unless: a player's Orbitals already play it
a player's Sentinel already plays it

bed.fill: On the last bar of every 8-bar phrase the clap pattern gains a pick-up on step 15 and the hats double for the second half of the bar. Seeded by the run seed and the bar number, so every device in a co-op run plays the same fill.

build.gain: section_gain.build: ramps from the first value to the second across the Build
build.layers: the bed as it stood when the Build began, with these changes
build.snareRoll: Split the Build into four equal parts: quarter notes, eighths, sixteenths, thirty-seconds. Level rises 0.35 -> 1.0 across the Build.
build.bass: fades to half level across the Build and stops for its second half
build.riser: noise riser over the whole Build
build.lastBar: kick, hats and stabs are silent; the snare roll and the lead stop after beat 2; a reverse swell fills the last half bar. The silence is the point.
build.time: the game runs at 85% speed for the last bar; the tempo map follows it inside the bar and returns on the downbeat

drop.impact: sub impact on the downbeat when the Drop follows a Build
drop.surge: for the first half of the Drop every player's lead runs faster, in two gears: one grid step faster for the first half of the Surge, two steps for the second half (see lead.grid). Without upgrades that is 1/16 triplets, then 1/32. The user heard both on 2026-11-11 (captures/m2/surge_compare.mp3), liked both and left the choice to the lead: both are kept, one after the other.
drop.intensity: the bed ignores director intensity during a Drop: everything plays

layers: hat_off at half level through a 5 kHz low-pass
break.lead: while a player is not firing, the bed echoes that player's arpeggio sparsely: steps 0, 6 and 12
break.swell: a reverse swell over the last bar leads into the next Groove

lead.note: The player's primary weapon. A note sounds on every grid step on which that player's fire is held; the arpeggio position is the step's position in the bar whether or not earlier steps sounded, so the melody is always in place.

grid.note: Double-Time moves one step along per stack; Surge moves one further in its first half and two in its second (drop.surgeSteps), capped at 1/32. On the triplet grid step k plays arp[k mod 16].

lead.accents: velocity 1.0 on quarter-note beats, 0.82 on the other eighths, 0.7 on the rest
lead.pan: wanders gently: 0.25 x sin(0.9 x step + bar)
lead.others: each device plays its own player's lead at full level and the others' at 0.35, falling to 0.15 beyond 1200 wu

mods.note: What each Mod does to the lead or adds to the mix, per stack (the first slice's since M3; the rest came from sound_m5.json in M5). Scale degrees are steps of the Track's scale above the arpeggio note.

split.perStack: adds one harmony note at 0.6 level

ricochet.perStack: none on the lead; each bounce plays a blip one scale step above the last

fork.perStack: on a first hit the note is answered a 1/32 later by the fifth above at 0.4

seeker.perStack: each lead note glides in from the note before it over 12 ms

heavy_step.perStack: every fourth lead step (3, 7, 11, 15) is doubled an octave down on the bass patch at 0.8; its explosion is the small kill's thud at 0.5

accent.perStack: the accented note (beat 1; then 1 and 3; then every beat) plays at 1.4 with the chord's stab under it at 0.3

echo.perStack: the lead's delay is one beat long and its mix rises by 0.15

wave.perStack: vibrato on the lead: 5.5 Hz, 18 cents

rear_guard.perStack: a counter-melody two scale degrees below the arpeggio on the off-beat eighths (steps 2, 6, 10, 14) at 0.5; the second stack adds the note five degrees below on steps 1 and 9

arc.perStack: each chain is a zap one chord tone above the last, up to three

burn.perStack: a crackle whose density follows the number of burning enemies (none to thirty), at 0.08

shatter.perStack: a glass burst on each kill that throws shrapnel, at 0.25

gravity_rounds.perStack: a soft low thup on each hit (sine 180 to 120 Hz, 40 ms) at 0.15

afterimage.perStack: the Dash's sweep is heard again a beat later at half level, from where the decoy stands

shockstep.perStack: the Dash adds a tom on the chord's root; a Perfect Dash a second tom a fifth above

aegis.perStack: a high tick for each bullet the arc stops, 6 dB under the Shard chirp (the first number, 0.15 of the tick, came out at -63 dBFS: nobody would have heard it)

last_light.perStack: the free mini-Nova is the Nova's blast at 0.6, without the inhale

collector.perStack: the Boost it spawns arrives with the Boost bells

on_beat_crit.perStack: notes on quarter-note beats are doubled an octave up at 0.5 level

syncopation.perStack: off-beat notes are 0.3 louder and carry a short square blip an octave up

bar_line.perStack: the cross is the chord's stab at 0.5 with a zap, on the One

crescendo.perStack: the lead rises 0.2 dB for each bar without a hit, to +2 dB, and the pad opens with it; a hit drops both at once

kick_pulse.perStack: a tom an octave above the kick's pitch doubles each kick at 0.2: on Tracks whose kick is not on every beat the ring follows the kick, not the beat

afterparty.perStack: the Surge's lead gear holds for the two extra bars

riffs.note: Each Riff is one instrument on one pattern, heard only while a player owns it. 'pattern' is 16 steps, digits are velocity ninths. Level 1 values; higher levels follow GAME_DESIGN 6.3.

orbitals.says: a tick as each orbital passes twelve o'clock

pulse_ring.says: a thump with each ring, every second beat; every beat from level 2

sentinel.says: an off-beat chord stab with each shot

lancer.charge: a reverse swell at 0.3 over the three beats before
lancer.says: a full chord on beat 4, the beam; from level 3 on beats 2 and 4 ('....9.......9...')

minelayer.drop: a closed hat on step 8 as each mine is laid
minelayer.says: the mines of the last bar go off together on the One

storm_coil.notes: the chord's stab triad and its root an octave up, in turn, one octave above the stab
storm_coil.says: a zap on each triplet eighth on which something was struck

swarm.notes: the chord's arp from step 0, one note a missile
swarm.says: the volley is a rising run on the One

singularity.says: a reverse swell while it pulls, the boom on the next One

mirror.says: the wingman is the player's own lead an octave up

comet.says: out on the One, back on three

sweeper.says: a drone that opens as the arm comes round to twelve o'clock and closes behind it

flak.says: a snare with each burst, on two and four; from level 4 a clap a 1/32 after it as the pellets go off

boosts.note: For the Boost's duration. Every Boost is picked up with the Boost bells.
boosts.prism: the lead gains a fifth and an octave above at 0.4 level for its duration
boosts.hyper: lead.grid and every Riff pattern run at double rate
boosts.supernova_rounds: each impact is the small kill's thud at 0.3
boosts.colossus: the bass gains its octave below at 0.5; each enemy rammed is a tom on the chord's root
boosts.time_stretch: the drums play at half rate (every pattern stretched to two bars) while the lead and the Riffs keep their grid: the room slows, the player does not
boosts.freeze_frame: a glass chord as it starts; the music bus is high-passed at 800 Hz for its two bars; each shattered enemy is a glass burst
boosts.magnet_storm: the Shard run climbs twice as fast
boosts.black_hole: the Nova's inhale lasts the singularity's three beats, rising; then the blast with the sub drop
boosts.chain_storm: on every beat a zap on each of the chord's three stab notes at 0.35
boosts.chorus: the lead is doubled a fifth above and an octave below at 0.4 each
boosts.beam: the lead holds: each step retriggers softly with four times the decay, over the Sweeper's drone on the arpeggio's first note
boosts.ricochet_fever: the bounce blips climb two scale steps a bounce
boosts.confetti: each kill adds a run of six Shard chirps up the scale
boosts.fractal: each lead note is followed a 1/32 apart by its octave at 0.3 and its double octave at 0.15
boosts.carousel: each launch is a tom: root, third, fifth and octave of the chord on beats 1 to 4

trackChange: On a boss kill the next Track's Break begins: tempo ramps linearly to the new tempo across the Break, the bed cross-fades to the new Track's pad chord by chord, and the key changes on the Break's fifth bar.
